# meca-rompe-hielo (ORM, docs/MECANISMOS_ADULTO.md, family F8, Caverna de Hielo), A: both ADULT at the entrance; red ice melted (two placements' keys and room 01's records); B entering later.
# Run with --transport ws; switches below (#! switches). Needs daurosk branch orm/meca-adulto (the `key` test
# command) on orm/test8 (the `warp ... adult|child`, LICHII_COOP_DUNGEON_LISTS). Generated by

# a 'test place ...: failed' or a 'goto timed out' is the scenario's gap, not the code's.

#! noload
#! start coop: test warp done
#! saves 14-hielo
#! switches LICHII_COOP_PUPPET=1,LICHII_COOP_DEBUG_FLAGS=1,LICHII_COOP_DUNGEON_LISTS=shared_dungeon_adult.txt
#! timeout 236
#! expect B coop: puppet: P\d: create CoopPuppet_Adult
#! expect A coop: test key 0x2c6b412d1c15fb39 = 1: queued within hielo..end
#! expect B coop: flags debug: key64 0x2c6b412d1c15fb39 \(record \d+\) 0 -> 1 within hielo..end
#! expect A coop: test key 0x755920da9d4a6670 = 1: queued within hielo2..end
#! expect B coop: flags debug: key64 0x755920da9d4a6670 \(record \d+\) 0 -> 1 within hielo2..end
#! expect A coop: test flag IceCavern_Room01_RedIce_Melted_01 \(0xa44793b3\) = 1: queued within registro..end
#! expect B coop: flags debug: bool 0xa44793b3 \(entry \d+\) 0 -> 1 within registro..end
#! expect A coop: test flag IceCavern_Room00_RedIce_Melted \(0x49eb1639\) = 1: queued within registro2..end
#! expect B coop: flags debug: bool 0x49eb1639 \(entry \d+\) 0 -> 1 within registro2..end
mark start
warp IceCavern IceCavern_FromZoraFountain adult

mark title
press A
wait 180
press A
wait 180
press A

mark hielo

wait 300
mark registro
flag IceCavern_Room01_RedIce_Melted_01 1
wait 300
mark registro2
flag IceCavern_Room00_RedIce_Melted 1
wait 300
mark tarde
wait 600
wait 300
mark end
